gist.summary: Added point-zero, a web-based AI chat app by @Developer-loqman-ameur, to the app catalog and README’s recent-apps list. Its listing describes a site for students, programmers, and content creators to chat with free models. The Basement Circuit rotated out of the README’s recent-apps list.
